correctness.rationale: The proposed set is proved strict 2-sumfree by a complete residue-block sum table modulo 9f-1 plus separate treatment of the two exceptional elements. Every omitted integer is covered by explicit strict pair-sum witnesses, which proves the greedy equality. The resulting difference word has a primitive period block of length 2f+2 and a nonextendable boundary, establishing the claimed minimal period and preperiod. The verification artifact separately checks representative greedy expansions and all residue certificates over broad finite parameter ranges.

originality.rationale: Van Berkel--Bosma arXiv:2609.18522 predicts the period and preperiod on d=2f but does not prove this infinite ray; the preceding arXiv:2609.16843 proves a region closer to the diagonal. Searches for S_{f,3f}, the modulus 9f-1, the period 2f+2, and equivalent 0-additive/non-additive terminology found no prior theorem. Queneau 1972 and Finch 1992 are the principal older sources not independently inspected in full, so prior coverage under historical notation remains a residual risk.

value.rationale: The result replaces finite computational evidence by a uniform proof on an infinite family outside the currently proved diagonal region, confirms both conjectured minimal lengths there, and supplies the stronger exact residue-class structure.
